token_near_graduation.meaning: the LaunchToken is near reaching BONDING_SUPPLY graduation

pair_deployed_before_graduation.meaning: the attacker deploys the (token, quote) pair before graduation

pair_token_reserve_wei.meaning: internal reserve of tokenA in the pair after the attacker's direct deposit and sync
pair_token_reserve_wei.checkpoint: after attacker deposit and sync, before graduation

attacker_quote_supplied_wei.meaning: amount of quote the attacker supplies to a newly created token to trigger the mass attack

graduation_token_deposit_pct.meaning: percentage of the token that graduation must deposit into the UniSwapV2 pool

graduation_quote_deposit_wei.meaning: quote amount graduation must deposit into the UniSwapV2 pool, equal to all held quoteReserve

held_quote_reserve_wei.meaning: all quoteReserve held by the launchpad at graduation

graduation_completed.meaning: graduation deposits 20% of the token and all held quoteReserve into the UniSwapV2 pool without reverting

assumptions: The attacker is an unprivileged caller able to deploy the pair and deposit 1 wei before graduation.
The 1 wei quote supply per newly created token is the attack setup magnitude stated by the impact.
Graduation is triggered by a buy reaching BONDING_SUPPLY.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker is permissionless/anyone; the mass-attack impact is asserted as potential without an explicit unprivileged-caller qualifier.
The 20% token deposit is stated as a percentage of the token; the report gives no absolute token amount, so the deposit is bound as the stated 20 percent figure rather than an absolute quantity.

limitations: Formalizes only the mass-attack impact i_mass_attack_1wei_per_token; permanent graduation disablement and forced quote withdrawal are separate impacts not covered here.
The 1 wei reserve is bound as the pair tokenA reserve after deposit and sync; the quote reserve being 0 is not separately encoded because it is not in the selected preconditions.
The all-quoteReserve deposit is bound as equality between the deposited quote amount and the held quoteReserve symbol; the held reserve value itself is symbolic.
